name: Murdaloc
summary: Agmond lies dead in the Badlands, with Murdaloc scratched into the sandstone beside his hand. Slay his killer and carry word to Prospector Ironband in Loch Modan.

sections.title: A Name in the Sandstone
sections.body: Blood marks Agmond's trail from the west, crossing stone and sand. It shows how far the dwarf crawled before he died. Beside his still hand, one word is scratched into the Badlands sandstone: Murdaloc. Slay Agmond's killer and a number of Stonevault Bonesnappers, then carry the news to Prospector Ironband in Loch Modan.

sections.title: Ironband's Reply
sections.body: Prospector Ironband receives the news with a sober face. He remembers Agmond as strong of arm, fierce with a hammer, and thick of skull. Ironband says cursed troggs killed Agmond. He believes Agmond took a good number of them down along the way.

faq.answer: Agmond was a dwarf who oversaw the excavation sites in the Badlands for Prospector Ironband. Your search for him ended at a skeleton.
Murdaloc is the name scratched into the sandstone beside Agmond's dead hand. Slay Agmond's killer, Murdaloc.

faq.q: Where does the report need to go?
aliases: who do i tell about murdaloc
faq.answer: Carry the report to Prospector Ironband in Loch Modan.
